# Better Music Overlay 1.5.1

Fixes missing automatic lyrics when the player uses an artist credit such as `DJ Example` and LRCLIB stores the matching recording as `Example`.

- The complete artist credit is checked first. A limited DJ-prefix fallback requires the exact normalized title, a matching album after Single/EP normalization, and a known duration within two seconds.
- Wrong artists, other albums, live/remix qualifiers and incompatible durations are still rejected. Other credit differences remain available through **Find recording**.
- A short overload of the full-credit search can recover through the alternate-credit search after honoring LRCLIB's cooldown. Rate limits and longer cooldowns stop requests.
- **Copy diagnostics** shows the alternate credit and request outcome. Matches retain their LRCLIB source URL and synchronization type.

Includes the **1.4.2 Apple Music metadata fix** and all **1.5.0 animations**: flowing lyrics, supplied-word reveal, smooth reader focus, ambient light, artwork halo, and configurable Motion settings.

Replace the old JAR in `mods` with the download matching your Minecraft version, then restart Minecraft. Enable **O → Lyrics → Show lyrics** and **LRCLIB lookup**. Existing settings and saved lyric corrections remain compatible.

Builds: **1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2, 26.3**. Requires Fabric Loader and the matching Fabric API. Native media integration supports Windows 10/11.

Verification: **486 test passes across six targets, zero failures**. All three opt-in live lyric checks passed separately, including an automatic credit-variant match with supplied Apple Music metadata. Packaged JARs passed version/target, dependency, smoke-harness exclusion and SHA-256 checks. Interface and animation checks remain those performed for 1.5.0.

# Better Music Overlay 1.5.0

Adds motion throughout the overlay and lyrics reader while preserving source-provided timing and the existing rendering limits.

- **Flowing lyrics:** the previous line fades upward as the new line slides into focus, with staggered entrances for upcoming lines and a tinted focus surface.
- **Word reveal:** words with supplied timestamps receive a short highlight reveal at their onset. Line-only lyrics and plain text do not receive invented word timings.
- **Smooth reader:** playback follow and the focus marker animate independently of the game tick rate. Scrolling still lets you browse manually.
- **Ambient light:** cached album-colored light drifts behind the card, an animated halo traces the artwork, and Aurora's progress marker gets a soft glow. These are decorative effects, not audio analysis.
- **Pause-aware artwork:** ambient movement and the halo follow playback position. Vinyl keeps its rotation angle when paused.
- **Motion settings:** use **O → Playback → Motion settings** or **Advanced → Motion** for Flow / Fade / Off, intensity, ambient drift, artwork halo, word reveal and track fades. The global Motion switch disables animation. Appearance profiles save these settings.

Includes the **1.4.2 Apple Music lyrics fix**, broader manual recording search, and the **Copy diagnostics** button.

Replace the previous JAR in `mods` with the download matching your Minecraft version, then restart Minecraft. Enable **O → Lyrics → Show lyrics** for the HUD and **LRCLIB lookup** for online lyrics. **Identity → Scene: Lyric Lounge** is a convenient starting appearance.

Builds: **1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2, 26.3**. Requires Fabric Loader and the matching Fabric API. Native media integration supports Windows 10/11.

Verification: **438 test passes across six targets, zero failures**. In-game checks passed on 1.21.11 and 26.3, including Motion controls and compact layouts. The raster benchmark and animated preview generator passed separately. Packaged JARs passed metadata, dependency, smoke-harness exclusion and checksum checks.

See the [animated preview and Motion settings](https://github.com/LootingVI/BetterMusicOverlay#new-in-15--motion-for-your-music).

# Better Music Overlay 1.4.2

Fixes Apple Music on Windows sending `Artist — Album - Single` as the artist while leaving the album field empty. Previous versions searched for the combined artist and rejected otherwise matching lyrics. Version 1.4.2 separates this Apple Music metadata into the artist and album used for lookup and ranking. Local lyric filenames and saved corrections stay compatible.

- **Find recording** falls back to a title-only search when the artist search returns no records. This makes differently credited entries available for manual selection. The chosen recording is saved for the track.
- **Copy diagnostics** in the lyrics reader copies the mod version, raw and normalized metadata, status, and request results. It excludes lyrics, artwork and local paths; Streamer mode redacts track details. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
- Automatic matching still checks the title, artist, recording qualifiers, and the two-second tolerance for a known duration. A broader manual search does not automatically select a different artist.

Replace the previous Better Music Overlay JAR in `mods` with the JAR for your Minecraft version, then restart Minecraft. Enable **O → Lyrics → LRCLIB lookup**. Enable **Show lyrics** for the HUD, or open the lyrics reader independently.

For an artist alias mismatch, open **Lyrics reader → Find recording**, click **Search alternate recordings**, cycle through the candidates and select **Use displayed recording**. If lookup still fails, use **Copy diagnostics** and inspect its current-track metadata before sharing it.

Builds: **1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2, 26.3**. Fabric Loader and the matching Fabric API are required. Native media integration supports Windows 10/11.

Verification: **66 tests per target, 396 passes, zero failures**. Two opt-in live LRCLIB tests passed separately, including synchronized lyrics for the reported Zensery recording using the combined Windows artist/album format. In-game checks on 1.21.11 and 26.3 exercised the lyrics reader and diagnostics clipboard action. Release JARs passed version/target, bundled dependency, smoke-harness exclusion and SHA-256 checks.

# Better Music Overlay 1.4.1

Fixes missing LRCLIB lyrics caused by differences in album metadata, particularly with Apple Music.

- Fallback search no longer filters out recordings because of a different album name. Album names now help rank otherwise matching results.
- Apple Music's `- Single` and `- EP` album suffixes are recognized when ranking results and removing an independently confirmed album suffix from the artist.
- Players that omit duration now get a search fallback. Conflicting recording lengths still require manual selection.
- An unsuccessful automatic lookup now points to **Find recording**, rather than claiming no lyrics exist.
- Song title, artist, live/remix qualifiers, and the two-second tolerance for known playback durations remain checked.

The reported **GERÄT (bitte cancelt mich 2)** / **Zensery** case was reproduced with a failing regression test. After the fix, a live lookup using Apple Music's public track metadata loaded synchronized lyrics from [LRCLIB record 32429053](https://lrclib.net/api/get/32429053).

Download one JAR for your Minecraft version and replace the old Better Music Overlay JAR in `mods`. Restart Minecraft, then enable **O → Lyrics → LRCLIB lookup**. Existing settings remain compatible.

Builds: **1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2, 26.3**. Fabric Loader and the matching Fabric API are required. Native media integration supports Windows 10/11.

Verification: **58 tests per target, 348 passes, zero failures**. Two separate live LRCLIB checks passed, including the reported recording. The six release JARs were checked for their version/target metadata, dependencies, exclusion of the development smoke harness, and SHA-256 checksums.

releases.notes:
# Better Music Overlay 1.4.0

The music studio now has sidebar navigation, rounded controls, switches, and a dedicated live preview. The lyrics reader and advanced settings use the same design, including compact layouts for small windows.

## Lyrics

- LRCLIB integration now reads Lyricsfile 1.0 and supplied word timestamps, alongside line-synced LRC and plain text. Word highlighting works in the HUD and reader when the recording provides timing.
- Alternate recordings distinguish WORDS, SYNC, and PLAIN. Invalid or unsupported rich data falls back to legacy lyric fields.
- Request identification, a 250 ms gap between requests, content-type checks, and complete Retry-After cooldowns follow the current LRCLIB documentation.
- Import local `.lrc` or `.txt` files by dropping them onto the import screen, or paste lyrics from the clipboard. Preview before saving; previous local files receive a `.bak` backup.

Enable **O → Lyrics → LRCLIB lookup** for online lyrics. No API key is needed. Lyrics availability and timing vary by recording. Local files take priority, and plain text receives no artificial timing.

## Performance

- Reused image and pixel buffers, cached backgrounds and UI surfaces, and bulk pixel uploads reduce rendering work and allocations.
- **O → Advanced → Rendering** adds Quality / Balanced / Saver presets with overlay limits of 30 / 20 / 10 fps. Balanced is the default. Minecraft's own frame limit is unaffected.
- With Motion off, unchanged cards skip painting.
- A focused local raster benchmark measured approximately 97% less Java allocation with buffer reuse. This does not establish an in-game FPS increase. [Measurement details](https://github.com/LootingVI/BetterMusicOverlay/blob/v1.4.0/docs/PERFORMANCE.md).

## Install

Download **one** JAR matching Minecraft **1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2, or 26.3**. Install Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer and the matching Fabric API. Replace the previous Better Music Overlay JAR in your instance's `mods` folder.

Minecraft 1.21.11 requires Java 21 or newer; 26.x requires Java 25 or newer. Native media integration supports Windows 10/11 and players that expose Windows media sessions. Your existing settings and appearance remain usable.

## Verification

53 automated tests passed on each of six targets: **318 passes, zero failures**. Separate live LRCLIB and allocation checks passed. Actual Minecraft 1.21.11 and 26.3 clients verified layout selection, lyric timing, file-drop import, rendering presets, and compact screens. Word-sync parsing is covered by deterministic fixtures. Release JARs include the YAML parser and exclude the development smoke harness. SHA-256 checksums are attached.

[Updated screenshots and setup guide](https://github.com/LootingVI/BetterMusicOverlay/tree/v1.4.0#readme)
